notes.title: The Imperivm saga reinforces its already fast-paced gameplay.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40969168/edee1d372e5c5e99eb89f06f0ff9996410ba8101.jpg[/img]

[h1]Imperivm / Reinforced its already fast-paced gameplay[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40969168/910df27e43baa68daf11869c7db9bcca0e4879a3.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]100 new features[/b], improvements, corrections, adjustments, and balances that reinforce already fast-paced gameplay.

Endorsed by more than [b]a million players around the world[/b], and become now an even greater strategic challenge. [/h3]

[h3][i][url=https://web.fxinteractive.com/docs/EN_Changelog_TOTAL_Imperivm_HD_v1_0]>>> Here you have all the improvements in detail...[/url][/i][/h3]

[h1]Imperivm / Take a BIG look [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40969168/de5ed6b14953c94b9cc0c3fbd23b721ccaa4eb20.jpg[/img]

[h3]It´s great to show at a glance the [b]1920x1080 graphics of the Imperivm HD units and warriors[/b].

A Full HD resolution offers [b]40% more battlefield[/b] to face an even greater strategic challenge than the original.[/h3]

[h3][i][url=http://web.fxinteractive.com/Imperivm.rtc.hd.oldschool.rts.rome.strategy.civilizations.guide.3840x7350/]>>> Here you have all the units and warriors in detail...[/url][/i][/h3]

[h1]Imperivm / New Civilizations Guide[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40969168/1264131c575a3572a836493484bc5ba318c228fd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Key information for each unit and warrior becomes the most complete tool for you to achieve the best results in each battle.

The size of the new Guide has been expanded by 100% so that at a single glance you can recognize the units, icons, and information of each unit and warrior.

[i][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uC3MXEx1iz9af6f2_7GcNylloRynSYh8qYdE4fjUGl8/edit#gid=2098556732]>>> Here you have all the info in detail...[/url][/i][/h3]
